name: StatusBar
description:
A general application status bar: `StatusBar` with `StatusBar.Start`, `StatusBar.End`,
`StatusBar.Item` and the live `StatusBar.Group`. `WindowFrame.StatusBar` and its parts are
built on these.
signature: ({ render, className, children, ref, ...rest }: StatusBarProps): ReactElement<unknown, string | import("react").JSXElementConstructor<any>>

props.name: ref
props.description: The element, for measuring or focus.

props.name: render
props.description: The element to render instead of a div. It keeps its own role (`<footer />`).

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.
